subject: a tiger head built from looping wax ribbons
pose: three-quarter head with one ear turned outward
art_direction: 半透明蜡带绕出虎头，紫橙分层与黑色细嵌条形成不寻常条纹，目光平静自信。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Construct a tiger head from thick translucent wax ribbons that curve around the cheeks and brow. Alternate warm amber and muted violet layers, using a few narrow charcoal inlays as stripes rather than realistic fur. The muzzle remains broad and pale, with small calm eyes and no open mouth. Turn the head slightly and angle one ear outward to give it quiet confidence. Render the wax translucency, softened cast edges, and subtle light passing through the ear tips. Keep the background warm cream and the shadow shallow. The head should occupy the central seventy-five percent of the square, with a clear rounded silhouette and no full body or surrounding objects.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
